rationale: C16 is a direct and highly concrete drafting predecessor. The child repeats C16's lengthy statutory and treaty recitals, its treatment of the general and Cuba agreements in parallel, its determination-based method for activating withheld Schedule XX concessions, and its machinery for deleting or modifying items in earlier recital lists. Both directives then organize the operative text into parts addressing the general agreement and the exclusive Cuba agreement. The child expressly identifies C16 as an earlier supplement and adapts its template to China's accession, a new effective date, and a new set of tariff amendments and rectifications. C18 and C11 are also closely related antecedents, but C16 is the nearest and most materially reused template.
